publishing only each sequence's accepted prefix?

| decision | result |
| --- | --- |
| position loop | rejected on value at 5.65059 ms per c16 K7 layer |
| fixed M128 projection | accepted at 2.01795 ms per c16 K7 layer |
| causal order | one kernel block owns one sequence and advances width 1 through 8 |
| state isolation | accepted convolution and recurrent pools are byte-identical before and after stage |
| prefix publication | mixed prefixes 0 through width match sequential K0 state byte for byte |
| numeric parity | every staged output matches sequential K0, 0 differing bytes |
| reset | discards private state without writing the accepted pools |
| telemetry cardinality | stage is one of 3 values, sequence bucket is one of 5 values, outcome is one of 4 values |

**Verdict.** Accepted for the rank-0 layer-0 GDN verifier primitive. One M128
projection replaces eight M16 projections. K7 state snapshots are written by
the causal kernels that produce them.

**Next.**

- bind the verifier to all 36 GDN layers and both ranks
- include the 72.646 ms K7 contribution in the assembled decoder roofline
- profile the c2 and c4 K7 variance in the assembled captured graph

**Reopen if.**

- a CUDA, CUTLASS, firmware, checkpoint, or GB10 revision changes the fixed
  projection or recurrent-state layout
